card.title: Before we start

lines.text: I use your family's plan names and the age you tell me — only to find in-network doctors. I don't save ages.
I use your family routine, like daycare drop-off, only to pick visit times.
Notes you tell me about a doctor stay with your family. No ratings.
I never read member IDs aloud.
I don't give medical advice or pick a specialty for you.

card.disclaimer: This information is not a substitute for professional medical advice. Consult a healthcare provider for personal medical decisions.
